name: Koo Rothscha
source:
Koo is one of the representatives of the Green Grass society and Hannah's childhood friend. She is very talented when it comes to managing money and has a crush on Hannah. 
[spoiler]In reality he is a male who is dressing as a female, due to the Rothscha family representatives being female.[/spoiler]
